concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) lists `quickstart.md` as a Phase 1 deliverable, but no task in `tasks.md` creates or updates this file. A task (e.g., T001_quickstart) is required to generate the quick‑start guide.
Phase 1 of the plan specifies `data-model.md` as an output, yet `tasks.md` contains no task that produces this document. Add a task (e.g., T002_data_model) to author the data‑model specification.
